description.value: Pizza Garden is a BC-based Neapolitan pizza chain with over 25 years in the industry, serving wood-fired pizzas with charred crusts, sun-ripened tomatoes, and fresh mozzarella. The West Vancouver Park Royal South location is one of more than a dozen locations across the province, from Victoria to Fort St. John. The chain offers both pickup and delivery with online ordering via app.

address.value: 704 Main St, West Vancouver, BC V7T 0A5

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Pizza Garden operates at 704 Main St under the label 'West Vancouver (Park Royal South) 704 Main St, West Vancouver, BC V7T 0A5', but the OSM record assigns this to the community 'North Vancouver' — these are adjacent but distinct municipalities, and the website postal code V7T 0A5 is West Vancouver. Takeout and pickup are explicitly confirmed by the website ('Choose easy pickup or have it delivered right to you'). No bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: OSM community field says 'North Vancouver' but the website's locations page explicitly lists this address (704 Main St) as 'West Vancouver (Park Royal South), BC V7T 0A5'. North Vancouver and West Vancouver are separate municipalities; the website and postal code indicate West Vancouver is correct. OSM community tag should be corrected.
Website contact page does not list individual store phone numbers, so the OSM phone (+1-604-912-0333) could not be confirmed or denied from website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating pizza restaurant with an active website, confirmed pickup/delivery service, and a listed location at this address. Suitable for the directory as a food stop for touring cyclists.
